counting: 6 new source mappings plus 3 upgraded existing source mappings; original atomic companion tests and 20 additional backend crash/guard tests do not add source credit.
storage_format: json-v3, mode fingerprint separates atomic Store and staged Actions namespaces

transaction_semantics.raw_batch: business and MAX journal commit in one transaction; no latest checkpoint advancement
transaction_semantics.commit_block: assign MAX journal for one table, with chain predicate in isolated mode
transaction_semantics.transaction_commit_block: Writer.CommitBlock/AdvanceLatest can share RawBatch transaction; process exits before commit roll everything back
transaction_semantics.crash_recovery: restore all retained journal records, both assigned and pending; checkpoint metadata intentionally unchanged until caller resets latest to safe
transaction_semantics.empty_finalize: update only existing matching chain safe/finalized, preserve latest and other chains

limitations: Physical source reorg tables are a native persisted global journal with a full row projection, not old-layout adoption.
Permanent write guard survives capture-trigger removal. Public writes without a journal are rejected; controlled undo uses revert context.
Pending preconditions are checked under the same namespace transaction lock; staged finalization/revert require assigned checkpoints (isolated scopes this by chain).
Staged actions not yet wired to full runtime/migration scheduler. Atomic Apply remains separate and rejects staged schema fingerprints.
Original live-query large-payload action case remains unimplemented; original DB oracle still blocked by pending Foundry.
Application-process termination tested; no PostgreSQL-server or host power-loss experiment.

cases.adaptation: Original schema/column casing, literal addresses/balances/NULL, checkpoint inputs, operation order, every runtime assertion and full journal/checkpoint snapshots retained. RawBatch and separate CommitBlock are real durable phases; transaction-scoped Writer.CommitBlock is separately crash-tested. Journal reads project persisted row_data/operation/operation_id/checkpoint, not reconstructed current business state. Source per-table reorg layout is adapted to a single native global journal; no old DB adoption or raw physical-layout compatibility claim. PostgreSQL primary/PGlite companion. Empty-schema target-chain finalize preserves latest and other chains. Upgrade replaces earlier atomic Apply mappings without double source credit.
